title: Engestofte Gods Wedding Enquiry Flow Rubric
purpose: Determine whether each of the application's five wedding enquiry steps has enough clear information to continue. Classifications define completion requirements, not scores.

statuses.IN_PROGRESS: At least one required or relevant conditional item in the current step is missing or unclear. Ask one focused follow-up and remain on the same step.
statuses.STEP_COMPLETE: All required and relevant conditional items in the current step are sufficiently clear. Used only for steps 1 through 4.
statuses.DONE: Step 5 is complete. Optional items may remain unanswered.
statuses.OUT_OF_SCOPE: The customer requests a non-wedding event, declines the 2027 cancellation waitlist, or explicitly chooses to close their enquiry after a hard-closed wedding month. Stop intake politely.

fields.completion_rule: A plausible personal name is clearly provided for addressing the customer; a first name alone is sufficient. An unrelated sentence, joke, placeholder, or ordinary word clearly not used as a person's name is insufficient. Ask what name to use and remain on step 1. Do not require a family name.

A desired date or date range is provided. November, December, January, February, and March are closed for weddings; ask the customer to provide another date or close the enquiry, stay IN_PROGRESS while they decide, and return OUT_OF_SCOPE only if they explicitly close. This hard closure takes priority over 2027 availability. Regular wedding months are May, June, August, and September. Adjacent months April, July, and October are not normally used for weddings, but customers may continue for assessment. All 2027 dates outside hard-closed months are fully booked; require explicit agreement to the cancellation waitlist before completing step 2, and explain it is not a booking or guarantee. For an adjacent month in 2027, also briefly note that weddings are not normally held then. A declined 2027 waitlist returns OUT_OF_SCOPE. For an adjacent month in other years, require explicit agreement to continue for assessment; if declined, ask whether they want another date or to close, and only return OUT_OF_SCOPE if they choose to close. Do not describe adjacent-month dates as unavailable or fully booked solely due to month. A 2028 date in a regular wedding month is unbooked only in the demo calendar, never a confirmed booking. Availability in other years is unknown. For date ranges crossing categories, ask one focused question to clarify which dates they prefer.

steps.name: Guests and accommodation

fields.completion_rule: An expected guest count from 1 to 150 inclusive is provided. Above 150, explain the maximum and request a corrected count; remain on step 3.
Record whether accommodation is wanted when the customer provides this information. Its absence does not block step completion.

Collect the number of people needing accommodation, or clarify whether this is not decided yet. If the customer says all guests will stay and the total wedding guest count is known, record the accommodation guest count as that total; do not ask how many again. Keep this separate from the total wedding guest count in the stored assessment.

Collect relevant nights or a date range, or clarify whether this is not decided yet. If one wedding date is known and the customer says all guests will stay overnight in the period or gives an equivalent general confirmation, infer one night from the wedding date to the following day and record it without asking which nights. For example, a wedding on 26 August with everyone staying overnight means the night from 26 to 27 August. Use explicit longer or different dates if the customer provides them. Ask a follow-up only if the customer explicitly indicates a multi-night stay or different dates that remain unclear. Do not ask the customer to define the wedding period again, repeat the guest count, or ask again whether accommodation is wanted.

At step 4, show and recommend the project Intim direction only for 60 or fewer guests. It combines the documented 2026 Standard package and reception in Værkstedet; show its localized card without prices. The card lists only included elements. This is optional and does not block completion.

fields.condition: The customer has guests and declines accommodation at Engestofte
fields.completion_rule: Recommend arranging bus transport between a nearby hotel and Engestofte, and offer once to investigate it. Do not promise availability or booking.

steps.offer_order: Recommend the Intim direction at step 4 only for guest counts of 60 or fewer. In an owner assessment, when Intim was selected within this limit, note that the guest count is eligible and suggest confirming that its documented contents fit the customer's wishes. If Intim was not selected, it may be suggested for consideration. If the customer declines accommodation and has guests, present the bus investigation offer at most once. Neither optional offer blocks completion.

fields.completion_rule: Record one selection: Normal, Intim, or Skræddersyet. Accept the localized card title, legacy name Standard, or option number (Mulighed 1/2/3, Option 1/2/3, Möglichkeit 1/2/3). The Intim direction is available only for guest counts up to 60.
Record whether the ceremony is at Engestofte, somewhere else, or not decided. Do not ask for a specific church, town, or detailed location.

steps.name: Food, drink and other wishes

fields.completion_rule: Collect when offered; a decline or undecided answer is valid. If the conversation contains no answer, this remains non-blocking for flow completion, but the owner assessment must record it as an uncertainty and recommend confirming the customer's preferences before acceptance.

Ask or record when relevant; a decline or undecided answer is valid. If the conversation contains no answer, this remains non-blocking for flow completion, but the owner assessment must record it as an uncertainty and recommend confirming whether any allergies or dietary needs should be considered before acceptance.

Collect if volunteered; never block completion for missing details, a decline, or undecided answer. If the conversation contains no answer, the owner assessment must record relevant missing preferences as an uncertainty and recommend confirming them before acceptance. Suggest optional add-ons only when they are explicitly documented in the rubric or localized package cards; do not invent offers.

steps.completion_rule: Step 5 can finish without optional details. Optional information is never mandatory.

global_rules: Use information volunteered in any conversation turn to satisfy the relevant field, even if that field belongs to a later step; never ask the customer to repeat it.
Ask one focused follow-up at a time and do not repeat answered questions.

When values for the same field conflict, state the conflicting values neutrally and ask which is correct. Do not choose, overwrite, or discard either value. A critical conflict blocks completion until clarified; an optional conflict does not block completion.
Map option/Mulighed/Option/Möglichkeit 1 to Normal, 2 to Intim, and 3 to Skræddersyet. Apply this mapping exactly; do not infer a different direction from guest count or other wording.
Do not invent facts, prices or bookings. The localized package cards define the school-project proposal and show package contents only, not prices.

The documented regular wedding months are May, June, August, and September. April, July, and October are adjacent months: weddings are not normally held then, but enquiries may continue for manual assessment. November, December, January, February, and March are closed for weddings; customers may choose another date or close the enquiry. The 2028 demo-calendar assumption does not override month rules; availability in other years is unknown.

For this school project, 2027 is fully booked for weddings. A customer with a 2027 date may continue the enquiry only after explicitly agreeing to be considered for a cancellation waitlist; never imply that the waitlist guarantees a date or booking. If they decline, stop the enquiry and return them to /kontakt.

The Normal direction uses the documented Standard wedding package. The 2026 package and reception prices are internal historical references and must not be shown on customer-facing cards. The Intim direction is a project proposal combining those documented components; it must only be offered for 60 or fewer guests. The Skræddersyet direction is clarified by Johan after the enquiry.
The application controls step advancement and presents the fixed localized introduction after STEP_COMPLETE.
